input.summary: kb_left_shift bound (Sprint -> mp_triple_puff, delay_on, evidenced at 46%). Every other control needed a question before it could be safely bound: kb_a and kb_s (Move left/Move backward) have evenly split habits across mouth-input vs joystick styles, so I asked which to use. kb_left_control (Slide/Horn) and kb_f (Interact/vehicle) have habits but no dominant winner or trigger-style clarity, so I asked. kb_c, kb_q, kb_y, dpad_E, dpad_W, dpad_N, dpad_S have no sourced in-game function in Cyberpunk's control list, so I asked what each does here as well as which historical binding (if any) should apply. kb_z, kb_e, kb_f2, right_trigger, left_trigger, Y, right_bumper, left_bumper, and X have no in-game function on record AND no history in any other profile, so I asked what they do and what should drive them. Nothing was proposed on guesswork; every unresolved control is now a pending question for the user to answer.
